title: hive-word close: request body
description: Closes an open or deferred question that has become moot, by evidence and never as an answer: the held work and everything beneath it archived, or the question asked again as another question that holds the same item. word persists it through hive-pool close-question, as one handoff, passing on the envelope's expected_revisions. See spec/word.md.

reason.description: Why the question is moot, in the owner's words.
